info.title: DebugLeaf Backend and Client API (proposal)
info.description: Consolidated static contract proposal for synthetic dispatch rehearsal and prepared-feature development inference. /api/v2 routes are not implemented; existing /api/v1 meanings remain unchanged. See DEBUGLEAF_BACKEND_ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW.md.

servers.description: Loopback local demo; use trusted LAN only after configured authentication and network review.

post.summary: Redeem a one-time driver pairing code

get.summary: Read this driver's canonical current manifest

post.summary: Durably admit a driver congestion event; evaluation does not publish a route
Request a route evaluation for this driver's current assignment; cannot approve or publish

get.summary: Read an owned job's durable state

post.summary: Approve a still-current proposal; publishes only through the atomic controller transaction

get.summary: Read fleet snapshot and pending proposal/job summaries
Read durable changes after a monotonic cursor; poll at 1-2 seconds while foreground

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Last applied feed sequence. Not a timestamp.

410.description: Cursor expired; payload includes current authorized reset snapshot

post.summary: Acknowledge own manifest revision; monotonic and idempotent
Development prediction from a complete, versioned 59-feature prepared row
post.description: Proposed only. This endpoint accepts prepared features and is not a raw-input preparation API. The present release fails the source audit integrity check and must remain unavailable until repaired and re-pinned. Never serve pre-pickup because actual pickup-time-derived values are required.

syntheticReleaseFixture.summary: Synthetic fixture; not operational source data

200.description: Development prediction. Numeric values are saved synthetic fixture expectations, not re-executed in this audit.

uncertainty.provenance: No deployed prediction interval in this release.

value.target_semantics: dataset_delivery_duration_min; operational event start/end not independently verified

422.description: Invalid schema, missing/extra feature, non-finite value, future feature timestamp, unsupported stage, or schema mismatch.

error.message: Prepared feature set must exactly match the frozen 59-feature contract.

503.description: Readiness, integrity, or dependency failure. Do not substitute synthetic v1 or a numerical fallback.

error.message: Configured model release failed its integrity check.
Configured model is not ready; no prediction was produced.
Configured model dependencies do not match the pinned release.

500.description: Unexpected inference runtime failure or non-finite output. No prediction or silent fallback.

error.message: Inference failed; no prediction was produced.

decision.reason: Candidate passed independent checks and benefit policy

error.message: Dispatch state changed; refresh before retrying

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Strong ETag of canonical base dispatch revision.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked credentials

Forbidden.description: Authenticated principal lacks the required role or ownership

NotFound.description: Missing or intentionally undisclosed unowned resource

Conflict.description: Stale version, idempotency mismatch, expired/not-pending proposal or competing approval

RateLimited.description: Pairing or event admission rate/capacity bound; may include Retry-After

Unavailable.description: Storage/runtime unavailable or bounded job failed; last committed plan remains active

DriverSession.description: Proposed session issued by pairing; server resolves immutable driver and vehicle ownership.

DispatcherToken.description: Server-configured dispatcher/admin token. Never provision to a phone.

LocalApiToken.description: Existing backend token-role middleware. Loopback-only when auth mode is explicitly disabled; never expose unauthenticated over LAN.
